latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing AI Generator Free — automatic video editing in the cloud.

- Upload raw video footage (up to 500MB) and request edits like trimming pauses, adding transitions, and auto-generating subtitles.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more; outputs 1080p MP4 files.
- No manual video editing required — describe your needs in plain language.
- Cloud GPU rendering, fast turnaround (typical edit ready in 1–2 minutes for short clips).
- Simple API token setup; free usage includes 100 credits with 7-day expiry.
- Provides automatic session management, error handling, and guidance for common workflows.
